meta.explainer: The world board lists the deadliest crawlers. Each time play starts, the app rolls once: usually nobody visits this floor; otherwise one of the top 10 names may appear. The other nine stay off-map. Floor purses are smaller than the posted board gold — see Bounties for stats on the top ten.

rows.name: Lucia Mar
rows.voice: She talks to the dogs. "Heel" is for them. "Sit" might be for you.
rows.quest: The board posts 5,000 on Lucia Mar. This floor pays 100 gp for her, dead, or for both dogs down and her walking into a pen.

rows.name: Hekla
rows.voice: Quiet Icelandic English. She counts under her breath and never raises it.
rows.quest: The board posts 4,500 on Hekla. This floor pays 90 gp if she dies here, or if she leaves the floor in a pen.

rows.name: Prepotente
rows.blurb: Brilliant goat with a terrible scream.
rows.voice: A goat who screams the answer before you finish the question. Brilliant. Unbearable.
rows.quest: The board posts 4,000 on Prepotente. This floor pays 80 gp for the goat, dead or penned. He is a crawler. He will tell you so.

rows.name: Florin
rows.voice: Barracks calm. He narrates the fight like he has already written it down.
rows.quest: The board posts 3,500 on Florin. This floor pays 70 gp when he stops being a problem. He will offer you a worse problem first.

rows.name: Quan Ch
rows.voice: Almost nothing. A count of three, then he moves.
rows.quest: The board posts 3,000 on Quan Ch. This floor pays 60 gp for him. He counts to three. You will hear it.

rows.name: Miss Quill
rows.blurb: Razor wit and sharper battlefield instincts.
rows.voice: Teacher voice. She asks permission like it's a pop quiz, and waits for the answer.
rows.quest: The board posts 2,750 on Miss Quill. This floor pays 55 gp. She will ask you something first. Answer, or don't.

rows.name: Gwendolyn Duet
rows.blurb: Calm under pressure and hard to surprise.
rows.voice: Pageant mic. She smiles at the camera first and at you second, if it is still on.
rows.quest: The board posts 2,500 on Gwendolyn Duet. This floor pays 50 gp. She is already performing. Decide if you are the audience.

rows.name: Signet
rows.blurb: A dangerous presence with royal poise.
rows.voice: Royal, and tired of it. She says "kneel" the way a host offers a chair.
rows.quest: The board posts 2,250 on Signet. This floor pays 45 gp. She may offer a different contract. Hear it before you swing.

rows.name: Li Jun
rows.voice: Fast talk, faster hands. He names his sister once and then doesn't again.
rows.quest: The board posts 2,000 on Li Jun. This floor pays 40 gp. He is looking for Li Na. She is not on this floor.

rows.name: Li Na
rows.voice: Soft until she isn't. She finishes his sentences and then the fight.
rows.quest: The board posts 1,800 on Li Na. This floor pays 35 gp. She is looking for Li Jun. He is not on this floor.
